t-lymphocyte.name: T lymphocyte
t-lymphocyte.visual_review: Inspected PNG and SVG on white and dark backgrounds: complete round cell, large nucleus and thin rim retained; purple palette and restrained depth match approved cells; no visible background, labels or unrelated objects. Fine trace retains nucleus shading.

activated-t-lymphocyte.name: activated T lymphocyte
activated-t-lymphocyte.visual_review: Inspected original and four-panel PNG/SVG comparison. Enlarged lymphoblast has more cytoplasm, visible nucleolus and organelles; complete silhouette, matching palette, real transparent padding. Fine color-region trace retains depth and components.

regulatory-t-cell.name: regulatory T cell
regulatory-t-cell.alias_reason: Unlabeled resting T-cell schematic reuses the resting lymphocyte archetype. Regulatory identity requires phenotype or function; inventing a distinctive naked-eye silhouette would mislead. Deliberate schematic inference under the inventory selection rule.

natural-killer-cell.name: natural killer cell
natural-killer-cell.visual_review: Compared PNG and path SVG on white/dark: eccentric indented nucleus, cytotoxic granules and complete cell preserved; palette consistent; slightly more textured than resting T cell. No background or extraneous objects.

b-lymphocyte.name: B lymphocyte
b-lymphocyte.alias_reason: Resting B and T lymphocytes share the small round cell, dense large nucleus and thin cytoplasmic rim at this schematic level. Reuse the resting lymphocyte archetype under the inventory selection rule.

plasma-cell.name: plasma cell
plasma-cell.visual_review: Inspected original and light/dark PNG/SVG panels. Oval plasma cell, eccentric clock-face nucleus, pale Golgi zone and abundant rough ER are retained. Matte outlined palette matches collection. Apparent glow in raw preview is not visible after alpha compositing; no opaque background.

monocyte.name: monocyte
monocyte.visual_review: Reviewed PNG/SVG on light and dark: folded kidney nucleus, fine scattered granules, small vacuoles and compact blood-cell outline are retained. Purple, blue and pink palette consistent. No opaque background or clipped intrinsic components.

plasmacytoid-dendritic-cell.name: plasmacytoid dendritic cell
plasmacytoid-dendritic-cell.visual_review: Inspected PNG and SVG comparisons on light/dark. Compact resting cell with eccentric lightly indented nucleus and developed ER, no long dendrites or clock-face chromatin. Palette and outlined forms consistent; trace simplifies subtle nuclear shading but retains recognizable structure and clean transparency.

eosinophil.name: eosinophil
eosinophil.visual_review: Inspected source and PNG/SVG white/dark comparison: two purple nuclear lobes with a narrow bridge, coarse orange-pink granules and intact round cell retained. No opaque backdrop or clipping. Fine trace keeps color, granular detail and pseudo-depth.

basophil.name: basophil
basophil.visual_review: Inspected original and four-panel comparison. Bilobed S-shaped nucleus partly obscured by dense indigo/violet granules; complete cell silhouette. Smooth saturated outlined drawing, accurate trace including shading and granules, clean on white and dark.

mast-cell.name: mast cell
mast-cell.visual_review: Inspected original and light/dark PNG/SVG panels. Single round unlobed nucleus with numerous violet-magenta granules; intact oval cell, no released granules. Consistent outlined palette and matched vector trace; background alpha composites cleanly.

erythrocyte.name: erythrocyte
erythrocyte.visual_review: Inspected PNG and SVG on white and dark backgrounds. Complete isolated coral-red anucleate disk, shallow central depression, crisp outline and transparent padding. Automatic trace flattened shading; reconstructed vector uses two editable contours and radial gradients, preserving recognizable depth with a slightly thinner silhouette.

platelet.name: platelet
platelet.visual_review: Inspected white and dark comparison: isolated anucleate discoid platelet, lavender peripheral zone, distinct magenta and purple granules, two small mitochondria and peripheral band. SVG preserves the PNG outlines, components and shading at display scale. Transparent exterior has no visible halo. Organelle sizes are schematic.

megakaryocyte.name: megakaryocyte
megakaryocyte.visual_review: Viewed both formats on white and dark: complete rounded cell outline, a single connected multilobulated nucleus, small granules, membrane channels and intrinsic organelles. SVG retains major shading boundaries and fine components with flatter nuclear shading than PNG, acceptable in the established illustration style. Generous alpha padding and no visible exterior halo.

hematopoietic-stem-progenitor-cell.name: hematopoietic stem/progenitor cell
hematopoietic-stem-progenitor-cell.visual_review: Inspected PNG and SVG on light and dark backgrounds. Round immature cell with large round nucleus, visible nucleolus and narrow cytoplasmic rim. Initial tracing lost shading; explicit trace-input color quantization now preserves broad gradients, fine outlines and intrinsic organelles closely. Original PNG remains unchanged. Morphology is a generic HSPC archetype, not a diagnostic identifier.

generic-epithelial-cell.name: generic epithelial cell
generic-epithelial-cell.visual_review: Viewed on white and dark backgrounds: complete soft cuboidal epithelial cell cutaway with central nucleus, nucleolus, ER, Golgi and mitochondria. PNG and SVG match closely in silhouette, coral/violet palette and shading. No external tissue, background or labels; transparent padding is clear. Cuboidal morphology is the chosen generic epithelial archetype.

columnar-epithelial-cell.name: columnar epithelial cell
columnar-epithelial-cell.visual_review: Compared PNG and SVG on white and dark: tall isolated columnar cell, basal oval nucleus, supranuclear Golgi, recognizable ER and mitochondria, bare apical surface. Formats preserve coral/violet palette, silhouette and internal shading closely. Exterior is transparent with generous padding and no visible glow.

ciliated-epithelial-cell.name: ciliated epithelial cell
ciliated-epithelial-cell.visual_review: Inspected PNG/SVG on white and dark. Complete apical cilia remain individually separated with visible basal attachments; oval basal nucleus and internal organelles retained. Matched coral/violet palette and shading, clear alpha exterior and padding. Cilia lengths reduced from the oversized first draft; fine structures remain schematic.

goblet-cell.name: goblet cell
goblet-cell.visual_review: PNG/SVG comparison on white and dark shows matching goblet silhouette, expanded apical cyan mucin granules, narrow basal region with violet nucleus, ER and Golgi. Smooth color gradients and individual granule outlines preserved. All components contained within cell, clear transparent exterior and padding, no labels or mucus plume.

keratinocyte.name: keratinocyte
keratinocyte.visual_review: Inspected PNG and SVG on white/dark: flattened polygonal nucleated keratinocyte, fine internal golden filament bundles ending at purple membrane-associated plaques, mitochondria and ER. SVG preserves fine bundles and broad shading at comparison scale. Clear transparent exterior and complete cell outline. Junctional pads are schematic intrinsic plaque components, without neighboring cells.

melanocyte.name: melanocyte
melanocyte.visual_review: Compared PNG and SVG on white and dark: one dendritic melanocyte with all connected branches and terminal tips intact, central violet nucleus, brown melanosomes throughout cell body and processes. Thin outlines, gradients and small granules preserved. Transparent gaps between branches and generous padding; no external halo, text or adjacent cells.

endothelial-cell.name: endothelial cell
endothelial-cell.visual_review: Inspected PNG/SVG on white and dark: complete flattened elongated endothelial cell, central oval nucleus, small purple rod-shaped WPBs with internal parallel lines distinct from pink mitochondria. Fine structures, smooth coral/violet shading and transparent exterior preserved. No vessel or adjacent tissue; intracellular sizes are schematic.

fibroblast.name: fibroblast
fibroblast.visual_review: Viewed PNG/SVG on white and dark: complete spindle-shaped fibroblast with both tapering processes intact, oval nucleus, abundant rough ER and compact Golgi. Matching colors, shading and organelles. Background retry produced actual alpha; no checkerboard or visible glow in final composite. No extracellular fibers or tissue.

adipocyte.name: adipocyte
adipocyte.visual_review: Compared PNG/SVG on white and dark: one large golden lipid droplet, narrow cytoplasmic rim, flattened peripheral violet nucleus and small organelles. SVG retains soft droplet shading with minor vector color banding, acceptable at illustration scale. Complete round cell, clear transparent padding, no extra droplets or tissue.

chondrocyte.name: chondrocyte
chondrocyte.visual_review: Inspected PNG and SVG against light/dark: one rounded cartilage-cell archetype with nucleus, abundant rough ER, Golgi and mitochondria. Fine organelle outlines and soft blue/violet shading closely retained. No matrix or lacuna; complete isolated cell with transparent padding. Unlabeled morphology alone is not a diagnostic identifier.

osteoblast.name: osteoblast
osteoblast.visual_review: Compared PNG/SVG on white and dark: complete plump cuboidal osteoblast archetype with eccentric nucleus, abundant rough ER, Golgi and basal secretory vesicles. Corrected first-draft ruffled edge to smooth basal surface. Fine components and coral/violet shading retained; no extracellular bone, labels or visible background residue.

osteoclast.name: osteoclast
osteoclast.visual_review: Five separate nuclei and complete ruffled lower membrane remain recognizable. PNG and editable path SVG match on white and dark backgrounds with transparent padding; no external glow survives alpha compositing.

osteocyte.name: osteocyte
osteocyte.visual_review: Thin branching processes remain connected and taper at visible tips. Single central nucleus and sparse organelles remain clear. PNG and path SVG retain the full silhouette on light and dark backgrounds with transparent padding; SVG has slightly stronger edge contrast.

skeletal-muscle-fiber.name: skeletal muscle fiber
skeletal-muscle-fiber.visual_review: Single unbranched fiber retains transverse striations, four peripheral nuclei and one enclosing outline. PNG and SVG preserve coral shading and complete ends on white and dark backgrounds; transparent padding verified.

cardiomyocyte.name: cardiomyocyte
cardiomyocyte.visual_review: One branching cell with a single central nucleus, transverse striations, mitochondria and terminal contact faces. PNG and path SVG match on light and dark backgrounds with complete silhouette and transparent padding; organelle sizes are schematic.

smooth-muscle-cell.name: smooth muscle cell
smooth-muscle-cell.visual_review: Complete fusiform outline and both tapering tips, central elongated nucleus and sparse oblique/longitudinal fibers remain recognizable without transverse striations. PNG and editable path SVG match on white and dark backgrounds with transparent padding; mild SVG contour banding at close zoom.

neuron.name: neuron
neuron.visual_review: Single multipolar soma with one continuous long axon and complete terminal boutons. Dendritic tips, nucleus and Nissl stacks remain recognizable. PNG and editable path SVG match on light/dark backgrounds with transparent padding; SVG has slightly stronger outline contrast.

astrocyte.name: astrocyte
astrocyte.visual_review: Stellate single cell with central nucleus, branching processes and small flattened endfeet. Complete silhouette and connected fine branches preserved in PNG and editable path SVG on light/dark backgrounds; slight vector edge contrast increase, no visible background residue.

oligodendrocyte.name: oligodendrocyte
oligodendrocyte.visual_review: Schematic single soma with four connected representative myelin segments. Concentric membrane layers, slender connections and transparent central openings preserved in PNG and SVG on light/dark backgrounds. Axons intentionally omitted; segment count and arrangement are schematic.

microglial-cell.name: microglial cell
microglial-cell.visual_review: Ramified single cell with compact soma, elongated nucleus and fine irregular connected processes. Branch topology and tips preserved in PNG and path SVG on white/dark backgrounds; SVG lines slightly stronger, no visible haze or checkerboard.

schwann-cell.name: Schwann cell
schwann-cell.visual_review: Single continuous myelin internode with outer nucleated cytoplasm and concentric lamellae. Central opening is transparent on white and dark backgrounds, complete sheath silhouette retained in PNG and path SVG. Axon omitted in this isolated cell schematic; mild SVG shading banding.

hepatocyte.name: hepatocyte
hepatocyte.visual_review: Rounded polygonal single cell retains central nucleus, abundant mitochondria, ER, glycogen clusters and small lipid droplets. PNG and editable path SVG preserve internal detail and complete outline on light/dark backgrounds with transparent padding; colors and organelle sizes are schematic.

pancreatic-beta-cell.name: pancreatic beta cell
pancreatic-beta-cell.visual_review: Single endocrine-cell schematic with numerous dense-core granules, pale rims, ER, Golgi and mitochondria. PNG and path SVG preserve detail and complete outline on white/dark backgrounds with transparent padding. Final cores are rounded; granule rims and organelle scale are schematic ultrastructural conventions, not a live-cell microscopy claim.

acinar-cell.name: acinar cell
acinar-cell.visual_review: Polarized single pyramidal cell with basal nucleus and rough ER, supranuclear Golgi and apical zymogen granules. PNG and editable path SVG preserve the organelle distribution, complete outline and short apical microvilli on light/dark backgrounds; transparent padding verified, granule sizes schematic.

podocyte.name: podocyte
podocyte.visual_review: Single-cell schematic retains broad primary branches and many short narrow foot processes with open gaps. PNG and editable path SVG preserve complete silhouette and intrinsic organelles on white/dark backgrounds with transparent padding. Neighboring cells and basement membrane omitted; process arrangement schematic.

renal-tubular-epithelial-cell.name: renal tubular epithelial cell
renal-tubular-epithelial-cell.visual_review: Representative proximal tubular cell: cuboidal body, short apical brush border, central nucleus and basal mitochondria among infoldings. PNG and editable path SVG retain complete outline and polarized details on white/dark backgrounds with transparent padding. Not intended to represent every nephron segment.

sperm-cell.name: sperm cell
sperm-cell.visual_review: Complete spermatozoon with acrosomal cap, condensed nuclear head, mitochondrial midpiece and one continuous unbranched tapering flagellum. PNG and path SVG preserve the full tail and colored components on white/dark backgrounds with transparent padding; schematic proportions.

oocyte.name: oocyte
oocyte.visual_review: Immature primary oocyte schematic with intact germinal vesicle, nucleolus, cortical granules and zona pellucida. PNG and editable path SVG preserve circular outline and internal detail on white/dark backgrounds with transparent padding. No polar body or mature meiotic-stage claim; organelle sizes schematic.

trophoblast.name: trophoblast
trophoblast.visual_review: Complete mononuclear cytotrophoblast schematic, gently polygonal epithelial outline, one nucleus and intrinsic organelles. Transparent on light and dark backgrounds. SVG preserves component layout and saturated palette, with mild gradient banding at close view.

generic-stem-cell.name: generic stem cell
generic-stem-cell.visual_review: Complete undifferentiated cell schematic, large nucleus with two nucleoli and sparse peripheral organelles. Clean transparency on white and dark. SVG preserves outlines and organelles with slight gradient banding; morphology is illustrative, not diagnostic of stemness.

induced-pluripotent-stem-cell.name: induced pluripotent stem cell
induced-pluripotent-stem-cell.alias_reason: Deliberate shared undifferentiated-cell schematic for an unlabeled single iPSC. Reprogrammed human iPS cells resemble embryonic stem cells morphologically; reprogramming history has no unique intrinsic icon. This is schematic reuse, not a claim that all generic stem cells are pluripotent or that morphology proves identity.

generic-cancer-cell.name: generic cancer cell
generic-cancer-cell.visual_review: Complete isolated atypical-cell schematic with irregular nucleus, two nucleoli and short membrane blebs. No visible background residue on white or dark composites. SVG preserves morphology and color with slight gradient banding; this is not diagnostic of a tumor subtype.

cancer-stem-like-cell.name: cancer stem-like cell
cancer-stem-like-cell.alias_reason: Shared unlabeled malignant-cell schematic: stem-like function is not assigned an invented unique organelle or universal cell shape. Tumor-initiating populations are experimentally defined using context-dependent markers and functional assays; reuse is an illustration-design inference, not morphological equivalence across all cancers.

multinucleated-giant-cell.name: multinucleated giant cell
multinucleated-giant-cell.visual_review: Seven separate nuclei within one shared continuous cell body; all short pseudopods complete. White and dark browser composites show clean transparency with no purple glow. SVG retains nuclei, small organelles and perimeter; count and arrangement are schematic.

mitotic-cell.name: mitotic cell
mitotic-cell.visual_review: Metaphase schematic with five visible duplicated chromosomes at the central plate, bipolar spindle and no nuclear envelope. Reduced chromosome count is explicitly documented. Complete perimeter and clean light/dark transparency. SVG preserves thin spindle fibers and centromere attachments with mild gradient banding.

cytokinetic-cell.name: cytokinetic cell
cytokinetic-cell.visual_review: Two daughter lobes remain joined by a narrow membrane-covered bridge with a central midbody and spindle remnants. One reformed nucleus per lobe. Complete silhouette and clean white/dark transparency; SVG retains connecting bridge and fine fibers with slight gradient banding.

apoptotic-cell.name: apoptotic cell
apoptotic-cell.visual_review: Attached membrane blebs and three irregular condensed chromatin fragments remain clear in PNG and SVG. Complete silhouette, no normal nucleoli inside fragments, no visible background residue on light/dark composites. SVG preserves contours with mild gradient banding.

necrotic-cell.name: necrotic cell
necrotic-cell.visual_review: Swollen cell with pale vacuoles, sparse mitochondrial cristae, fading nuclear material and a clear local plasma-membrane rupture. Complete asset and clean alpha including the rupture on white/dark. SVG retains damage morphology and organelle layout, with slightly stronger outlines and mild gradient banding.

senescent-cell.name: senescent cell
senescent-cell.visual_review: Representative spread senescent-fibroblast schematic with broad intact outline, enlarged irregular nucleus, lysosomal residual bodies and fine stress fibers. No background glow in white/dark composites. SVG preserves perimeter and organelles with mild banding; morphology is not a senescence assay.

polarized-migrating-cell.name: polarized migrating cell
polarized-migrating-cell.visual_review: Clear right leading fan and left trailing tail, branching actin network and complete filopodial tips. Transparent white/dark composites have no glow. SVG retains tail, fine actin strands and organelles with slightly stronger outlines; representative crawling-cell polarity only.

adherent-spread-cell.name: adherent spread cell
adherent-spread-cell.visual_review: Broad spread polygonal outline with five short extensions, one nucleus, peripheral adhesion plaques and stress-fiber bundles. All extensions complete, no background glow on light/dark composites. SVG retains thin fibers, organelles and contour with mild gradient banding.

rounded-suspension-cell.name: rounded suspension cell
rounded-suspension-cell.visual_review: Complete smooth rounded cell with one nucleus and moderate peripheral organelles. No attachment structures or long processes. Clean white/dark transparency; SVG retains cell edge and organelle contours with mild gradient banding.

cell-with-membrane-blebs.name: cell with membrane blebs
cell-with-membrane-blebs.visual_review: Four attached cytoplasmic blebs around one dominant cell body with an intact nucleus. No organs or nuclei inside the blebs and no detached cells. Clean white/dark transparency without glow. SVG preserves connected necks and round bulges with mild gradient banding; cause of blebbing remains unspecified.

phagocytic-cell-engulfing-a-particle.name: phagocytic cell engulfing a particle
phagocytic-cell-engulfing-a-particle.visual_review: One particle partially wrapped by an open phagocytic cup; kidney-shaped nucleus and complete pseudopods. Transparent exterior and cup gaps are clean on light/dark composites. SVG preserves particle separation, cup opening and cellular contours with mild gradient banding.

multinucleated-syncytium.name: multinucleated syncytium
multinucleated-syncytium.alias_reason: Reuse the existing macrophage-derived giant-cell illustration as one representative multinucleated syncytium: multiple nuclei in one continuous shared cytoplasm formed by fusion. This illustrates a documented syncytial form and does not imply that all syncytia have macrophage morphology.

cell-spheroid.name: cell spheroid
cell-spheroid.visual_review: Compact three-dimensional cell aggregate with closely apposed surface profiles and peripheral occlusion. Complete spheroid, one nucleus per visible profile, no extra cells or lumen. Clean transparency on white/dark; SVG preserves surface-cell boundaries and rounded shading with mild banding.

organoid.name: organoid
organoid.visual_review: Reviewed PNG and rendered SVG on light and dark: complete three-bud intestinal organoid cutaway, continuous lumen, epithelial cell ring, clean transparent padding. SVG retains structure and palette with slight contour banding. Representative intestinal model, not all organoid types.

nucleus.name: nucleus
nucleus.visual_review: Reviewed light/dark PNG and SVG: full interphase nucleus, intact pore-bearing shell and cutaway, nucleolus and chromatin preserved. Clean transparent margins; slight SVG gradient banding does not obscure structure. Pore count and chromatin pattern are schematic.

nucleolus.name: nucleolus
nucleolus.visual_review: PNG/SVG inspected on light and dark: complete membrane-free nucleolar cutaway, three pale centers and surrounding fibrillar regions retained. Fine detail and purple palette remain recognizable; trace has minor texture quantization. No checkerboard or background halo. Component sizes/counts are illustrative.

nuclear-envelope.name: nuclear envelope
nuclear-envelope.visual_review: Reviewed PNG and SVG on light/dark: complete double-bilayer patch, continuous curved membrane returns at pore edges, underside lamina retained. Transparent spaces and external padding are clean. SVG closely matches PNG with minor banding; pore architecture is simplified.

nuclear-pore-complex.name: nuclear pore complex
nuclear-pore-complex.visual_review: Light/dark PNG and SVG inspected: eight upper sectors with eight filaments, open channel, aligned scaffold rings and tapered basket retained. Six basket strands visible in projection. Clear transparent inter-filament spaces and margins; slight trace contour banding only. Simplified archetype, not atomistic reconstruction.

golgi-apparatus.name: Golgi apparatus
golgi-apparatus.visual_review: PNG and rendered SVG inspected on light and dark: five flattened curved cisternae, pale cutaway lumens and six associated/budding vesicles preserved. Clean transparent padding and no glow in composite. SVG retains crisp outlines and soft depth with slight gradient quantization.

rough-endoplasmic-reticulum.name: rough endoplasmic reticulum
rough-endoplasmic-reticulum.visual_review: Light/dark PNG and rendered SVG reviewed: interconnected cisternal sheets, empty pale lumens and small external ribosomes remain clear. True alpha including network openings; no glow or white background in composite. SVG maintains anatomy and palette with minor contour quantization.

smooth-endoplasmic-reticulum.name: smooth endoplasmic reticulum
smooth-endoplasmic-reticulum.visual_review: Light/dark PNG and rendered SVG inspected: complete branched tubular network, open loops, one cutaway tip, no surface ribosomes. Transparency is clean throughout openings and padding; no glow survives compositing. SVG retains smooth tube depth with minor banding.
